sloka: अपविद्धः च भग्नः च कस्य सांग्रामिको रथः ।रथ अक्ष मात्रा विशिखाः तपनीय विभूषणाः ॥३-६४-४८॥
transliteration: apaviddhaḥ ca bhagnaḥ ca kasya sāṁgrāmiko rathaḥ ।ratha akṣa mātrā viśikhāḥ tapanīya vibhūṣaṇāḥ ॥3-64-48॥

translations.english: Whose are these pointless arrows of the size of a chariot axle adorned with bright gold destroyed and scattered ? Who is he that has performed such terrible deeds?
